NEURO-DIVERSE CLUB

A safe space for Neuro-diverse learners

Enhance Learning Potential

If you like our work and would like to support us, please consider donating

SEND After School

Introducing our SEND After School Club, Croydon's first historic after school club that offers a safe and fun environment for children to engage in various activities. Join us for an exciting after-school experience!

SEND Hub

Our SEND Hub provides advice, guidance, and workshops to parents with Neuro-diverse children, as well as signposting them to other agencies for holistic support. Their aim is to help SEND families break the cycle of poverty.

Where learning meets fun and safety

Our SEND after school club offers fun activities and cultural trips that help children with special educational needs connect with others while learning important life skills. Join for an enriching experience!
